[vc_row][vc_column][eikra-vc-text-title style="style2" title="Department Of Sports"]

We pursue the mission not only because fitness is a key component to a well-rounded liberal arts education, but because recent research shows that regular physical activity enhances memory, improves cognition and problem-solving abilities, and elevates one's overall sense of well-being.

To prepare physical education leaders of high academic caliber, with a holistic development of body, mind and spirit nurtured with a strong commitment to serve humanity.

The department of physical education and sports of ATME College of Engineering, Mysuru was established in 2010 and has engraved a name for itself in several sports activities in VTU level and State level namely Softball, Baseball, Handball, Cricket, Throw Ball, Weight Lifting, Hockey, Wrestling, Best Physique, Table Tennis Wrestling and others games.

[/eikra-vc-text-title][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][eikra-vc-text-title style="style2" title="Vision"]

Department of Physical Education will strive to impart co-curricular and recreational activities to students and staff in campus and intercollegiate activities, by doing so strives to develop all-round engineers to the society and country.

 [/eikra-vc-text-title][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][eikra-vc-text-title style="style2" title="Mission"]

We try hard to be the best institution in identifying, delivering success by imparting modern techniques to reduce negative attitude of students and providing latest equipment and facilities so as to improve the students’ skills in physical activities.

[/eikra-vc-text-title][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][eikra-vc-text-title style="style2" title="Aim"]

To become the premier engineering college to provide value-based engineering education along with excellence in sports activities, thus to become one of the leading institutions in the society.

[/eikra-vc-text-title][/vc_column][/vc_row]
